full_scope: Current source: architecture, import and complete serial prefix from --full, then the remaining Godot scenarios in two parallel workers. Not a single uninterrupted serial CLI completion. Native visuals, benchmark and real Holepunch acceptance are separate.

performance.scope: Production render budget, one shared IPC serialization per broadcast and one local map; nineteen recipients are serialized fakes. Actual encrypted twenty-peer traffic is a separate sidecar test. No separate-device or WAN FPS guarantee.

limits: Initial weapon balance needs human playtesting.
One trusted physics authority; no cheat-proof host claim.
No separate-device/WAN FPS or NAT acceptance.
Recovery may rewind to its shared checkpoint and cancels in-flight attacks.
